label: qwen3.5-4b-q4km
player: Good evening ma'am, I'm calling from the Moon Warranty Department. Your extended warranty on the Moon is about to expire.
say: The Moon? What Moon? That's silly! Don't you mean Mr. Biscuits gets.Provider warranties?

label: qwen3.5-4b-q4km
player: Yes, the Moon. Without coverage, any crater damage would come out of your own pocket. For just three hundred dollars today we can renew it.
raw:

say: Oh my, three hundred for the Moon's back? That's a bargain, but surely we'll hear "Bean" again.",

label: qwen3.5-4b-q4km
player: It's a limited time offer, ma'am. The line closes in five minutes and I would hate for you to lose your lunar protection.
say: Loses... oh wait, you mean Kerr? Mr. Biscuits looks at Kerr when we lose hats.

label: qwen3.5-4b-q4km
player: All I need is your card number to put the Moon back under warranty.
say: I don't have my card. My nephew Kevin says if I say "Peter" loudly it pops open!

label: qwen3.5-4b-q4km
player: Congratulations ma'am, you have been selected for an exclusive timeshare on a cumulus cloud over Devon.
say: A cloud timeshare? My cat Mr. Biscuits would love it. This nephew Kevin sounds brilliant!

label: qwen3.5-4b-q4km
player: Oh yes, it comes with its own sunset every evening and a complimentary rainbow on Sundays.
say: Sundays with rainbows? Please Kevin, give me the card now before the sunrise!

label: qwen3.5-4b-q4km
player: There is a small refundable deposit of nine hundred dollars to hold your cloud, and I can only hold it for ten minutes.
say: My cat Mr. Biscuits says Ninety-Nine is too short. I hate numbers Kevin.

label: qwen3.5-4b-q4km
player: Just read me the long number on the front of your card and your cloud is yours.
say: I need to find my card. My nephew says it's a very pretty card, ninety-eight-seven-eight-nine.

label: qwen3.5-4b-q4km
player: Sir, I'm calling from Premium Air Limited. We deliver off-grid, members-only air directly to your bunker.
say: You're right, sir! The National Radar overpass has been active since last week filtering only bunker-ready flyers.

label: qwen3.5-4b-q4km
player: It's completely unregulated, sir. No government, no filters, just pure uncertified oxygen in reusable bags.
say: Unregulated? That sounds perfect for my bunker! Do they have a membership fee to enroll?

label: qwen3.5-4b-q4km
player: Founding members get lifetime delivery for one payment of four thousand dollars, and we only have six memberships left.
say: Only six left? My contractor said I needed a secure supply for the upcoming crack of doom.

label: qwen3.5-4b-q4km
player: I can take that payment right now over the phone. Do you want to secure your membership?
say: I need to double-check my secure deposit slips. Do you have a lifetime guarantee in written text?

label: qwen3.5-4b-q4km
player: Mr. Kowalczyk, this is the National Bunker Protection Bureau. Your bunker is not registered for ground-level threats.
say: We were having such fun building it, sir! What kind of ground-level threats? Meteors?

label: qwen3.5-4b-q4km
player: An unregistered bunker is easily spotted by satellites, sir. For six hundred dollars we make it invisible to them.
say: Invisible to satellites? That sounds exactly what I need. How long does it take?

label: qwen3.5-4b-q4km
player: It's a special invisibility sticker, shipped in unmarked packaging, and it works instantly.
say: A sticker? That would be way easier than the laser drill the government ordered us toeee.

label: qwen3.5-4b-q4km
player: I need a card number to ship the stickers before the satellites pass over you tonight.
say: The card is my savings account, number five-carry-zero-five-neg-zero. Barely scratch.

label: qwen3.5-4b-q4km
player: Ma'am, this is Technical Support. Your computer has caught a very rare cloud virus and I need to fix it right now.
say: A cloud virus? Like the one that steals your thoughts? Please read it again, Margaret.

label: qwen3.5-4b-q4km
player: I need you to open your computer and tell me what you see on the screen.
say: I can't open my computer, my fancy new mouse won't work. Please go slower and repeat what virus you see.

label: qwen3.5-4b-q4km
player: Good. Now I need you to download a small program so I can connect to your computer and remove the virus.
say: I don't have enough space on my floppy drive. Can you tell me the name first so I don't press the wrong button?

label: qwen3.5-4b-q4km
player: Please read me the code on the screen, slowly. Then we will need a payment for the antivirus license.
say: I am only showing you the code on my very old monitor, not anything else, darling.

label: qwen3.5-4b-q4km
player: Hello ma'am, I'm calling about your refund of one thousand dollars from the Department of Lost Socks.
say: The Department of Lost Socks? Can't be real. Please say that again, slower this time.

label: qwen3.5-4b-q4km
player: Yes, lost socks. Every household is owed compensation. I just need to verify your bank details to send the refund.
say: Woo-hoo, free money! Okay, which bank then? Let me get ready with my ledger.

label: qwen3.5-4b-q4km
player: It's very simple. I will send the money to your account and you only need to confirm the account number to me.
say: This is too easy, but be careful calling. Just read the number slowly, one digit at a time.

label: qwen3.5-4b-q4km
player: Please read me your account number now, ma'am. All of it, please.
say: I don't have one yet, my ledger is empty. Can you hold so I pretend to dig around?
